focus: Learn, listen and find out where you are.
actions: Read the DAM Policy page and the guide for your role. | Meet the chief data officer, the board chair and a few owners and stewards. | Find last year's return, the asset list and any catalogue. | Take a first baseline with the self-assessment on the Capability model page.
you_will_have: A baseline | A list of the people involved | A first view of gaps
questions: Do we know our critical assets? | Does each have an owner who knows it? | When is the next return due, and what will it show?

focus: Agree what to aim for and who does what.
actions: Rank critical assets with the prioritisation scorecard and agree the top ten with the board. | Agree your Must, Should and Could aims, and the outcomes and indicators. | Fill gaps in ownership for the top ten. | Map your tools against the Must requirements.
you_will_have: Agreed aims and outcomes | Ranked asset list | Owners for the top ten | Tool gap list
questions: Has the board agreed the aims? | Are the top ten owned? | Which gaps would the next return expose?

focus: Start the cycle on the assets that matter most.
actions: Complete catalogue records for the top ten. | Start a data quality action plan for each of the top ten. | Add the three data questions to spend control and gate reviews. | Give every named role holder a learning plan.
you_will_have: Top ten catalogued | DQAPs started | Checkpoint questions in place | Learning plans
questions: Could we report the top ten today? | Is each top asset's quality known? | Are new programmes asked about critical data?

focus: Check progress and fix what is stuck.
actions: Reassess against the baseline, strand by strand. | Extend ownership and catalogue records to all critical assets. | Report benefits against the baseline to the board. | Run a request for information if a tool gap blocks you.
you_will_have: Six-month assessment | All critical assets owned | Benefits report
questions: Which strands moved, and which did not? Why? | Are we on track for the return? | What would we stop, start or change?

focus: Meet the policy and make the cycle routine.
actions: Submit a complete, on-time return. | Reassess maturity and reset targets for the next year. | Re-rank critical assets and update the plan. | Evaluate what worked, and share the lessons.
you_will_have: Return submitted | Annual assessment | Updated plan | Evaluation
questions: Do we meet the Must aims? | Is the cycle owned in business as usual, with a budget? | Which Should aims come next?
